summary.zh: 用 C# 构建稳健的 API 与后端服务
summary.en: Build robust C#/.NET APIs and backend services

description.zh: 覆盖 async/await、依赖注入、EF Core、Dapper、配置与 xUnit 测试等后端常见写法。适合开发 .NET API、MCP server 或企业应用时参考，也用于评审 C# 代码。需要 .NET SDK。
description.en: Covers async/await, dependency injection, EF Core, Dapper, configuration and xUnit testing for backend work. Suits building .NET APIs, MCP servers or enterprise apps, and reviewing C# code. Requires the .NET SDK.
